headlines.title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged in final vote before midterms
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve has voted to keep interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation. NBC News' Brian Chueng reports on the central bank's final rate decision before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: James Talarico faces off against Trump in dueling Texas rallies in election’s final days
headlines.description: Voter enthusiasm in Lubbock, a Texas city of fewer than 300,000, underscored the stakes of a close Senate race in what Democrats call their best chance in a generation.

headlines.title: Dolores Huerta, farmworker and civil rights activist, dies at 96
headlines.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers, improving the lives of the country's mostly Latino farmworkers and changing the course of the labor movement.

headlines.title: No Clear Winner Yet in Israeli Election
headlines.description: Vote counting is underway in Israel following the pivotal elections on Tuesday. It could take days, if not longer, to know if Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will hold onto power. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimation to date.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: New look at texts, phone data leads to murder charge in 2011 ‘The People’s Court’ disappearance
headlines.description: A fresh look at cell phone data and text messages led to arrest of a Florida man accused of murdering his ex-fiancée within hours of their appearance on TV’s “The People’s Court” in 2011, court documents unsealed Tuesday revealed.

headlines.title: Chiefs coach defends signing kicker who was suspended after sexual misconduct allegations
headlines.description: Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid offered only a short explanation Wednesday when asked why the team was comfortable signing kicker Justin Tucker, who has not played in the NFL since 2024 after a string of sexual misconduct allegations.

headlines.title: Fed plans to eliminate some rate-setting meetings, chairman says
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve plans to eliminate some meetings devoted to setting interest rates in the next couple of years, Chairman Kevin Warsh said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged in its final major decision before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Hasan Piker files $72.5 million defamation suit against Scott Jennings
headlines.description: Hasan Piker has filed a $72.5 million defamation lawsuit against Scott Jennings, claiming Jennings deliberately and falsely said he supported lynching Black people.

headlines.title: Conservative influencer James O’Keefe charged with unlawful voting and identity theft in Minnesota
headlines.description: A Minnesota district attorney on Wednesday charged conservative influencers James O’Keefe and Cam Higby with felony counts of unlawful voting and identity theft.
